name: 05 - Seguimiento Inteligente y Cálculo de Próxima Sesión

parameters.query: SELECT th.*, u.name as client_name FROM treatment_history th JOIN clients c ON th.client_id = c.id JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE th.client_id = {{$json.body.clientId}} ORDER BY th.date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT recommended_interval, interval_unit, description FROM treatment_rules WHERE treatment_name = '{{$json.treatment_name}}' AND active = 1 LIMIT 1
